$comment: Every environment variable each Railway service reads, grouped by what happens if it is missing. `scripts/check-env.mjs` validates a .env file or the live environment against this; `scripts/setup.mjs` generates .env files from it; `services/*/.env.example` is rendered from it (node scripts/check-env.mjs --render-examples). `shared_with` means the SAME value must be set on both services. `overrides` marks an alias the code reads IN PREFERENCE to another key. Value checks: `format` (ed25519-pkcs8-b64 | ed25519-pub-b64url | url) and `min_length` (bytes, enforced by the code) FAIL; `recommended_min_length` only WARNs (the code accepts shorter); `forbidden` lists values the code ignores or treats as published, and FAILs. Any value containing `TODO-` is a placeholder (setup.mjs answer `later`) and FAILs. Values are never stored here.

ROSTER_SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY.doc: Core project service_role key. Server only. Bypasses RLS.

ROSTER_TOKEN_SECRET.doc: HMAC secret for student session tokens. Rotating it signs every student out.

ROSTER_TEACHER_SECRET.doc: x-teacher-secret header for enrollment routes. teacher-auth.js ignores the published value apteacher2627.

TEACHER_KEY.doc: Teacher login key for the dashboards and the FRQ regrade workflow (GitHub secret APSTATS_TEACHER_KEY). The code falls back to the published key apteacher2627 if unset, so it is required here.

ROSTER_PW_ENC_KEY.doc: Encrypts stored student passwords for the teacher console (crypto.js: 64 hex chars are the raw AES-256 key; any other string is sha256-hashed into one).

ROSTER_GRADER_SECRET.doc: Server-to-server secret for grade writes from the relay's FRQ grader. FRQ_GRADER_SECRET overrides it when set.

PARK_KEY_GRANT_SECRET.doc: Server-to-server secret for campaign key grants between roster and relay.

RECEIPT_ISSUER_PRIVATE_KEY.doc: Ed25519 private key, base64 PKCS8 DER (the format receipts.js loads; anything else silently disables receipts), that signs ledger receipts. The relay has its OWN issuer key; see REVIEW_GRANT_PUBKEY.

WALLET_KEY_SECRET.doc: Encrypts teacher-held Doge paper wallets (wallet custody). crypto.js disables wallet custody when it is shorter than 32 bytes.

USE_V3_GRADING.doc: Must be `true`. The v3 two-track grade engine is the only one the Desk understands.

PARK_RELAY_URL.doc: Relay service URL (identity.relay_url). Defaults to the original teacher's relay if unset.

FRQ_GRADER_URL.doc: Relay service URL again: the relay hosts the AI grader.

FRQ_GRADE_MODE.doc: `authoritative` in production; `shadow` to grade without writing.

OPEN_SIGNUP_SECTIONS.doc: Sections students may self-enrol into. Format `Key:Label;Key:Label`.

PC_TRACK_ENABLED.doc: Progress-check track in the grade. `true` for the full course.

PC_FIGURES_SUPABASE_URL.doc: Project holding the PRIVATE `pc-figures` storage bucket. In production this is the core project.

PC_FIGURES_SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY.doc: service_role key of that project (signed URLs for figures).

TRAINER_DECK_ALLOWLIST.doc: Decks the fleet-trainer cloud save accepts.

REVIEW_GRANT_PUBKEY.doc: Base64url Ed25519 public key (43 chars, 32 bytes) matching the RELAY's RECEIPT_ISSUER_PRIVATE_KEY, so roster can verify AI review grants. Code ships a default for the original teacher's relay; set it after generating the relay's key.

FRQ_GRADER_SECRET.doc: Override alias of ROSTER_GRADER_SECRET: server.js reads FRQ_GRADER_SECRET first and only falls back to ROSTER_GRADER_SECRET. Leave unset. If set, it is the effective grader secret and must equal the relay's ROSTER_GRADER_SECRET.

FRQ_CANARY_STUDENTS.doc: Comma list of student ids that get the FRQ grader first.

PAYOUT_AGENT_KEY.doc: Key for the Doge payout agent (tools/).

BLOCKCYPHER_TOKEN.doc: BlockCypher API token for on-chain Doge balance reads.

STUDENT_WALLET_OPTIN.doc: Comma list of student ids allowed to propose wallet addresses.

RETIRED_ISSUER_PUBKEYS.doc: Comma list of old issuer public keys still trusted for replay.

TEACHER_STAKE_ALLOWANCE.doc: Candy the teacher may stake per Study Break match.

PAYOUT_BATCH_CAP.doc: Max rows per Doge payout batch.

BCRYPT_COST.doc: bcrypt cost factor for passwords (clamped by the code).

SIGNUP_CLAIM_MAX.doc: Rate limit: signup claims per window.

SIGNUP_CLAIM_WINDOW_MS.doc: Rate limit window for signup claims.

VERIFY_IP_MAX.doc: Rate limit: sign-in attempts per IP per window.

FRQ_RECORD_MAX_PER_MINUTE.doc: Rate limit for FRQ draft records.

FRQ_STATUS_MAX_PER_MINUTE.doc: Rate limit for FRQ status polls.

FRQ_GRADE_CLAIM_LIMIT.doc: FRQ worker: tickets claimed per poll (frq-worker.js; code default 8, clamped 1..100).

FRQ_GRADE_MAX_IN_FLIGHT.doc: FRQ worker: concurrent grading calls (code default 4, clamped 1..32).

FRQ_GRADE_MAX_RPM.doc: FRQ worker: grading calls per minute (code default 20, clamped 1..600).

FRQ_GRADE_POLL_MS.doc: FRQ worker: poll interval in ms (code default 2000, clamped 1000..300000).

FRQ_GRADE_LEASE_MS.doc: FRQ worker: ticket lease in ms (code default 120000, clamped 5000..600000).

FRQ_GRADE_TIMEOUT_MS.doc: FRQ worker: per-call timeout in ms (code default 90000, clamped 100..600000).

FRQ_SHADOW_SAMPLE.doc: FRQ worker: shadow-mode sampling divisor (code default 4, clamped 1..100).

KEY_PURCHASE_ENABLED.doc: Buy Pico Park campaign keys with candy.

SUPABASE_URL.doc: Core Supabase project URL (identity.supabase_url). Code has a default for the original project; set it anyway.

SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY.doc: Core project service_role key. Server only.

ROSTER_TOKEN_SECRET.doc: Same value as roster's ROSTER_TOKEN_SECRET, so the relay can verify student tokens.

ROSTER_GRADER_SECRET.doc: Same value as roster's EFFECTIVE grader secret (roster's FRQ_GRADER_SECRET if set, else its ROSTER_GRADER_SECRET). Read by ai-grade-auth.js.

PARK_KEY_GRANT_SECRET.doc: Same value as roster's. Read by apstat-park/campaign-key-grant.mjs.

RECEIPT_ISSUER_PRIVATE_KEY.doc: The RELAY's own Ed25519 issuer key, base64 PKCS8 DER (signs AI review grants). Its base64url public key goes to roster's REVIEW_GRANT_PUBKEY.

GROQ_API_KEY.doc: AI provider for grading, appeals, tutor chat. At least one of GROQ_API_KEY / DEEPSEEK_API_KEY is required.

ROSTER_SERVICE_URL.doc: Roster service URL (identity.roster_url). Defaults to the original teacher's roster if unset.

CURRICULUM_URL.doc: Where the relay fetches the quiz curriculum: `<quiz_base>/data/curriculum.js`.

AI_GRADE_AUTH.doc: `log` (record auth outcomes only) or `enforce`. Any other value means `off`.

TEACHER_SECRET.doc: Teacher header secret for relay admin routes (Live Classroom sound switch etc.).

ROSTER_ADMIN_TOKEN.doc: Optional hardening for roster admin proxy routes.

AI_GRADE_MAX_BODY_BYTES.doc: AI grade routes: request body cap shared by all three routes (ai-grade-auth.js; the per-route keys below win).

AI_GRADE_MAX_PROMPT_BYTES.doc: AI grade routes: prompt cap shared by /grade and /grade-batch.

AI_GRADE_MAX_ANSWER_BYTES.doc: AI grade routes: answer cap shared by all three routes (code default 8192).

AI_GRADE_MAX_ITEMS_PER_MIN_SID.doc: AI grade rate limit per student id per minute (code default 30).

AI_GRADE_MAX_ITEMS_PER_MIN_IP.doc: AI grade rate limit per IP per minute (code default 600).

AI_GRADE_MAX_TRACKED_KEYS.doc: Rate limiter memory cap; fallback for the two keys below.

AI_GRADE_MAX_TRACKED_SIDS.doc: Rate limiter: max student ids tracked (code default 10000).

AI_GRADE_MAX_TRACKED_IPS.doc: Rate limiter: max IPs tracked (code default 2048).

APSTATS_TEACHER_KEY.doc: Roster's TEACHER_KEY. Used by the hourly FRQ regrade sweep workflow.

CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN.doc: Only if you re-enable the Claude bot workflows. Not needed to serve the course.

site_literals.doc: The static site has no environment. Its identity (base URLs, Supabase URLs and anon keys) is baked into the files by `config/identity.json` + `scripts/rebrand.mjs`.
